context: A business is deciding how to pursue growth.
stem: Select the statement that is a strategy rather than an objective or a tactic.

options.label: C
options.text: Serve budget-conscious customers through a low-cost offer supported by efficient operations and limited service.

options.label: D
options.text: Open three new stores next year.

option_rationale: A is an objective because it states a desired result.
B is a tactic because it is a specific action used to implement a wider approach.
C is correct because it sets out coherent choices about customers, value offered and supporting capabilities.
D is an action or target, rather than a coherent set of longer-term choices.
